page.layout: One printed page: title page, centred lines of text from top to bottom, a woodcut emblem of a tree with a man and a scroll reading "ARDVA" and "QVÆ" and "PVLCHRA" in the middle, then the imprint lines below the woodcut; a library stamp at the lower right, not transcribed.
page.notes: The woodcut emblem (a tree with a man embracing its trunk, a scroll reading ARDVA, QVÆ, PVLCHRA) is not transcribed as text. The imprint date is printed as CIↄ Iↄ C XLVI, i.e. MDCXLVI (1646). Spacing of the title lines is as printed; "Prusso-Regiomontani" is in italic with a long s rendered as "ss" in the print.
